pages.title: What are you naturally good at?
pages.message: Great! Now tell us about your natural strengths. Select up to 4 abilities that come most naturally to you.

options.label: Logical-Mathematical: data, numbers, puzzles
Linguistic: reading, writing, communicating
Musical: sounds, rhythms, music
Bodily-Kinesthetic: doing, moving, using hands
Spatial: visualize ideas and designs
Relationships: connect with others and teams
Intrapersonal: understanding my thoughts, feelings, motivations
Naturalist: working outside and connecting to nature
None of the Above: none of them describe me

pages.title: What global issues matter most to you?
pages.message: Now let's talk about what matters to you globally. Choose up to 3 issues that you care about most.

config.title: Pick up to 3 that matter most to you

options.label: 1: No Poverty - ending poverty and ensuring basic needs
2: Zero Hunger - access to enough nutritious food
3: Good Health & Well-Being - improving healthcare and well-being of all people
4: Quality Education - access to quality education and learning
5: Gender Equality - opportunities for all genders to thrive
6: Clean Water & Sanitation - improve access to quality education and learning
7: Affordable & Clean Energy - create clean energy sources
8: Decent Work & Economic Growth - job opportunities and fair working conditions
9: Industry, Innovation, & Infrastructure - inclusive and sustainable industrialization
10: Reduced Inequalities - help all people have equal opportunities
11: Sustainable Cities & Communities - sustainable and inclusive cities and communities
12: Responsible Consumption & Production - reduce waste to protect resources
13: Climate Action - protect our environment
14: Life Below Water - preserve our oceans and marine life
15: Life on Land - protect and restore forests, wildlife, and biodiversity
16: Peace, Justice, & Strong Institutions - building accountable and inclusive institutions
